info.name: NovaCart API
info.description:
REST API for the NovaCart store.

Run **Auth → Register customer** (or Login customer) and **Auth → Login admin** first; the test scripts store the JWTs in collection variables. Then run any folder, or the whole **Security proofs** folder to see unauthorized access being rejected.

Every error uses the same shape: `{status, code, message, errors?}`.

request.description: Creates a customer account and returns a JWT.
Returns a JWT valid for `expires_in` seconds (60 minutes by default).
A second customer, used by the security proofs.
Set the `adminPassword` collection variable first (ADMIN_PASSWORD, or the password printed by the seeder).
The signed-in user.
Exchanges a valid or recently expired token for a new one; the old token is blacklisted.
9 per page, newest first.
Filter by category id.
Includes up to three related products.

exec: pm.test("Unified error format", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.keys(["status","code","message"].concat(j.errors ? ["errors"] : [])); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Cart contents and customer, before placing the order.
Places an order from the cart. Prices and stock are recalculated on the server; add a product to the cart first.
Only the signed-in customer's orders.
multipart/form-data. Pick an image file (JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB) in the `image` field.
pending → completed or cancelled; completed → cancelled. Cancelling restores stock. The customer is notified.
Refused with 409 when the product appears in an order.
Paginated; `meta.unread_count` holds the unread total.
